note: Public data does not establish these. Virtual Metal is not physical verification.

items.property: undocumented XL330 firmware scheduling and exact RAM restore after REBOOT
items.why_it_matters: REBOOT then WRITE timing and which RAM fields return to e-Manual initials vs retained EEPROM.
items.public_data_status: partial (e-Manual lists RAM initials; restore order unpublished)
items.current_virtual_assumption: reset_ram() writes e-Manual RAM initials; EEPROM retained
items.smallest_real_experiment: Scope one REBOOT on a real XL330-M288; capture RAM registers before/after with Protocol 2.0 READ.

items.property: true boot-timing distribution after VIN apply and INST_REBOOT
items.current_virtual_assumption: Truth-pack boot_delay_s sampled in [0.3, 1.5] s; not slept in Tier 1
items.smallest_real_experiment: N>=30 reboot-to-first-PING samples on the intended USB-UART adapter.

items.property: USB adapter quirks (DTR-RESET, echo, latency, CH340 vs FTDI vs U2D2)
items.why_it_matters: Echo vs status scan; DTR can reboot the servo on open
items.current_virtual_assumption: PTY echo optional; no DTR pulse model
items.smallest_real_experiment: Identify adapter; measure DTR pulse vs servo reset; latency histogram on live bus.

items.property: real voltage sag under stall at 5.0 V
items.why_it_matters: VIN register vs wizard limits; false brownout
items.current_virtual_assumption: Present voltage is the commanded surrogate voltage; no sag model
items.smallest_real_experiment: Current-limited 5 V supply; log VIN register and shunt current during a stall pulse.

items.property: EMI / packet corruption rate on the real half-duplex bus
items.why_it_matters: CRC error frequency vs injected CorruptOutgoingCrc
items.current_virtual_assumption: Corruption only when a fault is scheduled
items.smallest_real_experiment: Long capture of CRC errors during hold and nudge on the bench harness.

items.property: actual mechanical backlash and gearbox efficiency
items.current_virtual_assumption: Campaign samples gearbox_efficiency and scales vmax/stall; backlash excluded
items.smallest_real_experiment: Optical or encoder-external measurement of horn hysteresis; compare stall torque vs input current.

items.property: manufacturing variation of stall torque and no-load speed
items.why_it_matters: Envelope used as a hard clamp may be optimistic or pessimistic per unit
items.smallest_real_experiment: Measure stall and no-load on the specific serial unit, store as CALIBRATED_FROM_REAL_HARDWARE beside manufacturer values.

items.property: real holding torque at conservative PWM Limit 200
items.why_it_matters: Hold-still campaign assumes the PWM cap can hold
items.current_virtual_assumption: PWM frac scales vmax; no separate holding-torque model
items.smallest_real_experiment: Apply known load at hold; observe present-position drift.

items.property: real thermal response and shutdown timing
items.public_data_status: Temperature Limit 70 C published; time constant unknown
items.current_virtual_assumption: Temperature is a set-point; OverTemperature fault writes 90 C immediately
items.smallest_real_experiment: Loaded run until Present Temperature approaches Temperature Limit; record Hardware Error Status and torque-off time.

items.property: actual power-cut behavior (USB unplug vs VIN cutoff)
items.current_virtual_assumption: Disconnect fault drops the byte path; not a VIN cutoff
items.smallest_real_experiment: Operator-attested live unplug and VIN cutoff with lost holding torque, as required by the metal experiment.

items.property: kernel/driver timing vs 40 ms live I/O and 100 ms watchdog
items.why_it_matters: Late ACK vs software watchdog miss
items.current_virtual_assumption: VirtualMetalPort timeout 40 ms; DelayStatus records delay
items.smallest_real_experiment: Run scripts/metal-campaign.sh on native Linux with the real UART; do not substitute PTY or Virtual Metal.

items.property: physical hot-swap identity (USB iSerial vs dest-only CH340)
items.current_virtual_assumption: Virtual serial VM-XL330-M288-1; no USB iSerial
items.smallest_real_experiment: Unplug/replug the same and a different adapter; confirm serve refuses the mismatch.

items.property: e-Manual Input Voltage error bit 0x01 vs 0x10 wording conflict
items.why_it_matters: Hardware Error Status and Shutdown mask interpretation

items.smallest_real_experiment: Induce under-voltage on a real XL330; READ Hardware Error Status(70).
